title: DRMYN Studio: Repository-Native Continuity and Look-Specific Alias Governance for AI-Assisted Film Production
description: DRMYN Studio is a metadata-only, schema-validated, human-gated research software framework for AI-assisted movie development and movie production process design, documentation, validation, and reproducibility. This checkpoint (v0.14.0-continuity-alias-checkpoint) completes the PROD-LINE-14A through PROD-LINE-14H continuity governance layer: character identity anchors, look-variant records, scene-to-character-look maps, and a look-specific Kling/Omni element alias architecture with scene-to-alias resolver and operator hint report. The repository records canonical source truth, planning metadata, prompt governance, validation evidence, human approval decisions, agent handoffs, and reproducibility artifacts for an AI-assisted film production workflow. It includes 55+ JSON Schemas (draft 2020-12), a three-agent autonomous orchestration layer, and a Film Aesthetic Bible system. This release is a metadata-only scientific software checkpoint; before PROD-LINE-15 external-ref write pass. Generated media outputs are stored externally and referenced through metadata-only records. Demonstrated through the Closing Price AI-assisted film project.
